questions.prompt: Mbese igitabo cyawe kiri he? Kiri mu nzu.
questions.answer: Where is your book? It's inside the house.

questions.prompt: Ibi bijumba ni bito cyane. Ibinini biri he?
questions.answer: These sweet potatoes are very small. Where are the big ones?

questions.prompt: Iguhugu cy'Abanyarwanda ni gito cyane.
questions.answer: The country of the Banyarwanda is very small.

questions.prompt: Hari ibiti birebire mu murima we. Ibiri hano ni bigufi. Dukwiriye gutera ibinini.
questions.answer: There are tall trees in his garden. Those that are here are short. We must plant big ones.

questions.prompt: Ndashaka kurya igice cy'ikijumba.
questions.answer: I want to eat a piece of sweet potato.

questions.prompt: Shyira biriya bigori mu muriro.
questions.answer: Put those cobs of corn in the fire.

questions.prompt: Igihugu cyacu ni cyiza. Umujyi wacu mukuru witwa Kigali.
questions.answer: Our country is good. Our capital city is called Kigali.

questions.prompt: Uyu muhungu afite igisebe kibi ku kirenge cye.
questions.answer: This boy has a bad sore on his foot.

questions.prompt: Uriya muhungu afite ibisebe ku mubiri we wose.
questions.answer: That boy has sores all over his body.

questions.prompt: Mbese uzi kuvuga Ikinyarwanda? Oya, sinzi Ikinyarwanda.
questions.answer: Do you know (how) to speak Kinyarwanda? No I don't know Kinyarwanda.

questions.prompt: Ndashaka kumenya Ikinyarwanda, ariko birakomeye!
questions.answer: I want to know Kinyarwanda, but it is difficult!

questions.prompt: Bariya bagore ntibakwiriye gutera ibijumba none.
questions.answer: Those women should not plant the sweet potatoes today.

questions.prompt: I don't want many things. Just a few pieces of sweet potato.
questions.answer: Sinshaka ibintu byinshi. Ibice bikeya by'ikijumba gusa.

questions.prompt: Put it on the large mat.
questions.answer: Gishyire ku kirago kinini.

questions.prompt: This is only a small part of his book.
questions.answer: Iki n'igice gitoya gusa cy'igitabo cye.

questions.prompt: Come out of their country. There are many thieves in their country.
questions.answer: Va mu gihugu cyabo. Mu gihugu cyabo har'ibisambo byinshi.

questions.prompt: Put your (plural) feet on the mat.
questions.answer: Shyira ibirenge byanyu kuri iki kirago.

questions.prompt: We don't want to read the book now. We want to plant the trees in their gardens.
questions.answer: Ntidushaka gusoma igitabo ubu. Turashaka gutera ibiti mu mirima yabo.

questions.prompt: They don't like thieves. Thieves are not good people.
questions.answer: Ntibakunda ibisambo. Ibisambo s'abantu beza.

questions.prompt: There are many feet in the road. There are only a few in the path.
questions.answer: Har'ibirenge byinshi mu muhanda. Har'ibirenge bikeya gusa mu nzira.

questions.prompt: These children love sweet potatoes and corn. They do not like meat.
questions.answer: Aba bana bakunda ibijumba n'ibigori. Ntibakunda inyama.
